'''Kosul Ayada''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] faithfully for many years, dying several decades before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the eventual rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]], Kosul Ayada was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], eventually attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. A noted Jedi, Ayada took many [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] during his career and successfully trained them to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|knighthood]]. His last student was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] boy named [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]], who went on to train as a [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Guardian]] of the Order and earn a seat on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. When Ayada became one with the Force, Koth constructed a [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|lightsaber hilt]] that resembled the Herglic's own as a way of memorializing his master.<ref name="TEVD" />
